info.description: A comprehensive eCommerce system API with product management, shopping cart, and order processing
info.title: eCommerce API

post.description: Requires the current password. On success every other session is signed out.
Verifies credentials and returns an access/refresh token pair. Repeated failures lock the account temporarily.
Revokes the supplied refresh token. Idempotent: an unknown token also returns success. The access token remains valid until it expires, so clients should discard it.
Revokes every refresh token belonging to the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns the profile of the authenticated user. The identity comes from the token, never from a request parameter.

post.description: Exchanges a refresh token for a new pair. The old refresh token is invalidated on use, so always store the one returned here.

401.description: Invalid, expired or already-used refresh token

post.description: Creates a customer account and returns an access/refresh token pair. Passwords must be at least 8 characters, contain a letter plus a number or symbol, and must not echo your name or email.

get.description: Retrieve an existing cart or create a new one for the specified user
get.summary: Get or create a cart for a user

get.description: Retrieve a shopping cart with all its items

post.description: Add a product to the shopping cart

delete.description: Remove an item from the shopping cart

post.description: Create an order from a shopping cart and process payment

get.description: Retrieve all orders for a specific user
Retrieve detailed information about a specific order

post.description: Cancel an order and restore inventory

put.description: Update the status of an order (Pending, Confirmed, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled)

get.description: Retrieve a list of all products in the catalog

post.description: Create a new product in the catalog

get.description: Get detailed information about a specific product

delete.description: Delete a product from the catalog

valid.description: Valid is true if Time is not NULL

models.AuthResponse.description: Issued token pair plus the authenticated user

models.LoginRequest.description: Credentials used to obtain a token pair

role.description: Role drives authorization checks in middleware.RequireRole.
